entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Jodhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel Shri Bhansali submits that the application dated 15.03.2010 filed on behalf of the petitioner before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nagaur under Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 has not been decided till date.
He further submits that the inaction of the trial court is absolutely unjustified and vitiates the trial.
The Registrar (Judicial), Rajasthan High Court, Jodhpur is directed to summon a report in this regard from the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nagaur forthwith.

It is further directed that in case, the second sample of the seized food article has not forwarded to the Central Forensic Laboratory till date, the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nagaur shall take immediate steps in this regard.

(SANDEEP MEHTA),J 34-Tikam/-
